full_text_en:
Xi Chunlin et al. v. Huajiadang Town Seed Supply Station — dispute over compensation for damages from seed purchase and sale

Plaintiffs: 505 households of villagers in Huajiadang Town, Shishou City, Hubei Province.

Litigation representatives: Xi Chunlin, Wang Xianfang, Zhang Yinzhu, Hu Changyan, Zeng Fanlü, all being villagers of Huajiadang Town, Shishou City, Hubei Province.

Defendant: Huajiadang Town Seed Supply Station, Shishou City, Hubei Province.

Legal representative: Xiang Yang, Stationmaster.

Third party: Original Seed Farm of Hunan Provincial Rice Research Institute.

Legal representative: Zhang Zhaodong, Farm Director.

The plaintiffs, 505 households of villagers in Huajiadang Town, Shishou City, Hubei Province (hereinafter referred to as the seed users), filed a lawsuit with the Shishou City People's Court of Hubei Province against Huajiadang Town Seed Supply Station (hereinafter referred to as the Seed Supply Station) concerning a dispute over compensation for damages arising from the purchase and sale of seeds. Because the outcome of the case was related to the interests of the Original Seed Farm of Hunan Provincial Rice Research Institute (hereinafter referred to as the Original Seed Farm), the court notified it to participate in the proceedings as a third party.

Plaintiffs' Allegations: In March 1992, the plaintiffs purchased "Xianghua No. 1" rice seeds from the defendant and planted and managed them in accordance with the technical data provided by the defendant. However, the growth of the rice was inconsistent with the various data and performance described in the materials, with uneven heading and maturation, causing the plaintiffs a reduction in yield amounting to over RMB 180,000 in losses. Therefore, the plaintiffs requested that the defendant be ordered to compensate for the losses.

Defendant's Defense: The rice seeds sold by the defendant to the plaintiffs were purchased from the third party; after the phenomenon of uneven heading and maturation of the rice occurred, the defendant telegraphed the third party seven times requesting them to send personnel to handle the matter, but the third party evaded responsibility on various pretexts. Therefore, the defendant had no fault whatsoever in the reduction of the plaintiffs' rice yield and should not bear liability. The plaintiffs' losses should be compensated by the third party.

Third Party's Defense: The "Xianghua No. 1" rice seeds used by the plaintiffs were a new strain bred by the third party through the use of the latest modern scientific biotechnology, anther culture and selection. Because the climate was abnormal this year, the plaintiffs failed to adopt corresponding cultivation measures in response to the abnormal weather conditions, thereby causing the reduction in rice yield. Hence, the reduction was unrelated to the third party and should be borne by the plaintiffs themselves.

Facts Found by the Shishou City People's Court: In February 1992, the defendant Seed Supply Station purchased 10,080 kg of "Xianghua No. 1" early rice seeds from the third party Original Seed Farm and sold them respectively to the plaintiffs and other 505 households of villagers for sowing. The seed users carried out field management of the early rice planted on 1,344 mu of responsibility fields in accordance with the technical data provided by the Original Seed Farm together with the seeds, but the result was uneven heading and early maturation. Verified by senior agronomists of the Shishou City Agriculture Bureau: the per-mu yield of the seed users' early rice could only reach 240.7 kg, which was 209.3 kg less than the minimum per-mu yield data provided in the Original Seed Farm's technical data, causing a reduction loss of over RMB 180,000.

It was also found: The 10,080 kg of "Xianghua No. 1" rice seeds provided by the third party Original Seed Farm to the defendant Seed Supply Station were a strain trial-planted on a small regional area and had not been examined and approved by the Hunan Provincial Crop Variety Approval Committee.

Opinion of the Shishou City People's Court: The production and business activities of crop seeds shall be conducted in accordance with the "Seed Management Regulations of the People's Republic of China" and the "Detailed Rules for the Implementation of the Seed Management Regulations on Crop Seeds" (hereinafter referred to as the Detailed Rules) issued by the Ministry of Agriculture under the authorization of the State Council on June 24, 1991. Article 33 of the Detailed Rules stipulates: "Varieties that have not been examined and approved or have been examined but not approved shall not be marketed, produced, promoted, reported for awards, or advertised." Paragraph 1 of Article 40 also stipulates: "The production of commercial seeds shall implement the system of 'Seed Production License'." The third party Original Seed Farm, by putting the unapproved small-area trial rice seeds into commercial production and promoting them across provinces, violated the above provisions and was the direct cause of the reduction in the seed users' yield, and shall bear primary liability according to law. The defendant Seed Supply Station, as a seed business entity, failed to verify whether the rice seeds had been examined and approved and whether a "Seed Production License" existed when purchasing the seeds from the Original Seed Farm, thereby also having fault in causing the reduction in the seed users' yield and shall bear secondary liability. After the Shishou City People's Court ascertained the facts and distinguished right from wrong, both the Seed Supply Station and the Original Seed Farm acknowledged their respective faults to the plaintiffs. The Seed Supply Station expressed willingness to pay RMB 40,000 in compensation to the plaintiffs, and the Original Seed Farm expressed willingness to pay RMB 60,000 in compensation to the plaintiffs, requesting the plaintiffs to withdraw the lawsuit. The plaintiffs agreed to the compensation amounts proposed by the Seed Supply Station and the Original Seed Farm, were willing to settle the matter amicably, and after receiving the compensation payment, formally filed an application for withdrawal of the lawsuit with the court. Upon examining the plaintiffs' application for withdrawal, the Shishou City People's Court held that the three parties to the case had already settled amicably, and there was no need for the court to continue the trial. The plaintiffs' application for withdrawal complied with the provisions of Article 131, Paragraph 1 of the "Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China". Accordingly, on August 25, 1992, the court ruled: The plaintiffs' withdrawal of the lawsuit is permitted. Court acceptance fee of RMB 2,550 shall be borne by the plaintiffs.

Given that the defendant Seed Supply Station and the third party Original Seed Farm, in violation of the provisions of Articles 73 and 75 of the "Detailed Rules for the Implementation of the Seed Management Regulations on Crop Seeds", marketed and promoted unapproved rice seeds, causing significant economic losses to the plaintiffs, the Shishou City People's Court, in accordance with the provisions of Article 134, Paragraph 3 of the "General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China", imposed civil sanctions on their illegal acts:

1. Confiscation of the Original Seed Farm's illegal income of RMB 10,000 from seed sales, and a fine of RMB 5,000;
2. A fine of RMB 3,000 on the Seed Supply Station.
